notes.title: Warbot Creator released!!!
notes.content:
The time has come! You finally get to play with the warbot creator!

Please keep in mind that this is a very early, bare-bones version of the creator, so don't expect too much content in there yet.

Some other updates:
- Performance optimisation
- Map setting added to allow warbots to see through walls
- Map setting added for friendly fire

This is a major update and unfortunately, old maps will NOT BE COMPATIBLE with this version.

tags.feature: - Map setting added to allow warbots to see through walls
- Map setting added for friendly fire

notes.title: Adding building prefabs and Workshop integration!
notes.content:
Hey guys and girls and others,

We've just made another update where we've added the following:

- You can save your buildings as prefabs now so you can re-use them in other maps.
- We've added steam workshop integration so you can upload your maps and building prefabs and share them with other players.
- This also means you can try maps and building prefabs made by other players. Simply subscribe to them on the workshop.

Just remember to use the playtest workshop from your Steam client. Don't use the workshop from the Age of Warbot steam page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323178/5248d144ee177a33a7ac06b40b01bda2c4d3ae74.png[/img]



In the next update we'll be adding the warbot editor so you can make your own warbots.

notes.title: New playtest build!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Thanks so much for all the feedback you've given on the play test. Looks like so far people are having a good time playing the game which we're so happy about!

We just uploaded a new build containing some bug fixes and changes based on your feedback:

- Translations are fixed
- Bots and their body components disappear a few seconds after death to prevent blocking of other units and also to improve the performance of the game 
- Bots do not shoot when blocked by an obstacle
- When selecting units, an info pop up will appear giving you extra information on the bot
- Some players in eastern Europe had problems running the game. This should be fixed now.
- Turning shadows off messed up with how Forcher's shield looks. This is fixed now.
